svg.title: Unlimited hf spectrogram
svg.desc: Waterfall of the hf transmission of Hi in the 300-2700 Hz passband: tune, sync markers, two packages and END, all on 1500 Hz, with the 276 Hz occupied band and the room to mistune.
svg.text: Spectrogram of the hf transmission “Hi”: everything on one pitch
Real Encoder audio at 8000 Hz; STFT with a 16 ms Hann window every 1.0 ms; power in dB relative to the strongest cell.
The frame is the SSB 2.4 kHz passband (300–2700 Hz): the tune, the markers and the beeps all sit on 1500 Hz; silence is a 0.
